title: Footballer Omar Marmoush Undergoing Tottenham Medical for Loan Deal
summary: Footballer Omar Marmoush is undergoing a medical examination with Tottenham Hotspur. The move is a loan deal with an obligation for Tottenham to purchase him permanently from Manchester City. The transfer is expected to be finalized soon.
summary_points: Omar Marmoush is undergoing a medical with Tottenham Hotspur.
The deal is a loan with an obligation to buy.
Marmoush is moving from Manchester City.
The transfer is expected to be finalized.

summary_hi: फुटबॉलर उमर मारमश टोटेनहम हॉटस्पर के साथ मेडिकल जांच से गुजर रहे हैं। यह सौदा मैनचेस्टर सिटी से उन्हें स्थायी रूप से खरीदने के दायित्व के साथ एक लोन डील है। यह स्थानांतरण जल्द ही अंतिम रूप दिए जाने की उम्मीद है।
